name: search_memory
description: Search locally stored activity text. Results contain ranked snapshot metadata and short excerpts. Use get_snapshots when an answer depends on exact wording or details beyond an excerpt.

query.description: Two to four distinctive search terms; non-empty, no control characters, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

name: get_chronicle
description: Return a generated activity summary for an hour, day, week, month, or year. Use snapshots when exact source wording is required.

period.description: Period key matching the selected level; non-empty, no control characters, at most 64 UTF-8 bytes.

name: get_working_memory
description: Return the newest active snapshots from the bounded local working set, including full captured content and focused-element context.

name: get_recent_activity
description: Return a chronological index of foreground activity from the immediate look-back window. Fetch a snapshot when its excerpt is insufficient.

name: get_snapshots
description: Fetch full captured content and metadata for specific snapshot identifiers.

ids.description: Snapshot identifiers returned by another activity tool. Each must be non-empty, contain no control character or comma, and use at most 128 UTF-8 bytes; the encoded list may use at most 8192 bytes.

name: search_wiki
description: Search locally generated pages about people, projects, topics, tools, and organizations.

query.description: Entity name or topic; non-empty, no control characters, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes.

name: get_wiki_page
description: Fetch one locally generated wiki page, its related links, and the snapshot identifiers supporting it.

slug.description: Page slug or entity name; non-empty, no control characters, at most 256 UTF-8 bytes.

name: list_wiki
description: List local wiki pages, optionally filtered by page type.

name: get_time_report
description: Return locally calculated foreground-time totals and project classifications for a named period or inclusive date range.

from.description: Inclusive start date in YYYY-MM-DD format; at most 32 UTF-8 bytes.

to.description: Inclusive end date in YYYY-MM-DD format; at most 32 UTF-8 bytes.

name: list_time_rules
description: List time-classification rules with their identifiers, match fields, projects, and sources.
